messages:
Lina: Quick note: proposing a compact onboarding flow + priority score so PMs can triage faster. Three lanes: Sprint (2-4w), Standard (8-12w), Fortify (12+w, private/regulatory).

Ravi: Score idea?

Lina: Lightweight: score = round((impact*rev_tier)/(infra_cost + risk + kernel_flag)). impact 1-10, rev_tier {community:1,paying:3,enterprise:5}, infra_cost 0.1-10, risk 0-10, kernel_flag 0 or 1.5. High->higher priority.

Tess: Canary defaults?

Lina: cohort=min(0.5% tenant traffic,2k req/day), duration 48h gen/72h embed. Auto-halt: p50>baseline+25ms OR errors+4% OR eval safety drop>2.5pts OR hallucination>1.4x.

Owen: Pin tiers?

Lina: 14/60/365 days. Pins>60d require paid commitment or reserved capacity; exemptions need legal+security signoff and backport SLA.

finance-bot: Please attach a billing worked example (10M tokens/month at +12% unit cost) when you RFC.

Lina: Will draft RFC + scoring sheet + two billing worked examples and schedule a 30m sync. Quick reactions here?

Ravi: +1
Tess: +1
Owen: +1
